####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To simulate the population above the serological threshold under different 
vaccination ages and a targeted delay during the bad season
####################################################################################################

# Set up

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read in files 

```{r}
prob_threshold_files <- list.files(glue("{dirs$modres}/modres_population"), full.names = TRUE) %>%
  str_subset("to")

dat_cov <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/modres_population/dat_cov.rds"))

dat_phase <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_phisumm.rds")) %>%
  filter(mod %in% dat_cov$mod_best) %>%
  mutate(min_week = round(((phi_mean - 1 + 26) %% 52) + 1)) %>%
  select(pat, mod_best = mod, clu, min_week)
```

# Baseline simulations 

```{r}
sim_baseline <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_population/sim_baseline_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {mod_x}"))
    # Probabilities 
    dat_prob <- readRDS(str_subset(prob_threshold_files, str_remove_all(mod_x, ".rds")))
    
    # Simulation baseline 
    dat_pop <- dat_phase[which(dat_phase$mod_best == mod_x), ] %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_prob$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
        mutate(scenario = "baseline",
           bad_season = FALSE,
           delay = 0,
           vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
           age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
  
    # Bind and summarise 
    left_join(dat_pop, dat_prob, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
      group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
      summarise(protected = sum(n * prob) / sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay) %>%
      summarise(protected_mean = mean(protected),
                protected_med  = median(protected),
                protected_cilo = quantile(protected, 0.025),
                protected_ciup = quantile(protected, 0.975),
                .groups = "drop")
  })
})
```

# 6 Weeks more or less simulations
```{r}
sim_delay06moreless <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_population/sim_delay06moreless_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {mod_x}"))
    
    # Define delay 
    delay_l <- if(dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8) 1:8 else 1:26
    # Probabilities 
    dat_prob <- readRDS(str_subset(prob_threshold_files, str_remove_all(mod_x, ".rds")))
    
    # Simulation baseline 
    dat_pop <- dat_phase[which(dat_phase$mod_best == mod_x), ] %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_prob$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
      mutate(scenario = "delay06moreless",
             bad_season = abs(((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26) <= 6) %>%
      crossing(delay = delay_l) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
             age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
  
    protected_draws <- map_dfr(delay_l, \(delay_x) {
      dat_pop_x <- filter(dat_pop, delay == delay_x)
      
      # Bind and summarise 
      left_join(dat_pop_x, dat_prob, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
                relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        filter(age_ini <= (max(age_ini) - max(delay))) %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
        summarise(protected = sum(n * prob) / sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay) %>%
        summarise(protected_mean = mean(protected),
                  protected_med  = median(protected),
                  protected_cilo = quantile(protected, 0.025),
                  protected_ciup = quantile(protected, 0.975),
                  .groups = "drop")
      })
    return(protected_draws)
  })
})
```

# Out delay simulations
```{r}
sim_delayout <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_population/sim_delayout_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {mod_x}"))
    # Probabilities 
    dat_prob <- readRDS(str_subset(prob_threshold_files, str_remove_all(mod_x, ".rds")))
    
    bad_window_l <- 1:26
    
    # Simulation baseline 
    dat_pop <- dat_phase[which(dat_phase$mod_best == mod_x), ] %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_prob$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
      mutate(scenario = "delayout") %>%
      crossing(bad_window = bad_window_l) %>%
      mutate(weeks_before = floor((bad_window - 1) / 2),
             weeks_after  = ceiling((bad_window - 1) / 2),
             week_from_min = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26,
             bad_season = week_from_min >= -weeks_before & week_from_min <=  weeks_after,
             out_season = ((min_week + weeks_after) %% 52) + 1,
             delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
             vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
             age = age_ini + delay)
    
    protected_draws <- map_dfr(bad_window_l, \(window_x) {
      dat_pop_x <- filter(dat_pop, bad_window == window_x)
      
      # Bind and summarise 
      left_join(dat_pop_x, dat_prob, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age), 
                relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, bad_window) %>%
        summarise(protected = sum(n * prob) / sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, bad_window) %>%
        filter(!any(is.na(protected))) %>%
        summarise(protected_mean = mean(protected),
                  protected_med  = median(protected),
                  protected_cilo = quantile(protected, 0.025),
                  protected_ciup = quantile(protected, 0.975),
                  .groups = "drop")
      })
    return(protected_draws)
  })
})
```

# 12 Weeks more simulations
```{r}
sim_delay12more <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_population/sim_delay12more_ratio_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {mod_x}"))
    
    # Probabilities 
    dat_prob <- readRDS(str_subset(prob_threshold_files, str_remove_all(mod_x, ".rds")))
    
    # Baseline population --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    dat_pop_baseline <- dat_phase[which(dat_phase$mod_best == mod_x),] %>%
      crossing(birth_week = 1:52, age_ini = unique(dat_prob$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1 = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1, 
             age = age_ini,
             n = 1000 / 2)
    
    # Baseline seroprotection for every posterior draw
    protected_base_draws <- dat_pop_baseline %>%
      left_join(dat_prob, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
      group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw) %>%
      summarise(protected_baseline = sum(n * prob) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")
    
    # Baseline recommended later seroprotection for every posterior draw 
    age_late_x <- if_else(dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8, 8, 52)
    
    protected_late_draws <- protected_base_draws %>%
      filter(age_ini == age_late_x) %>%
      select(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, draw, protected_late = protected_baseline)
    
    # Define delay 
    delay_l <- if(dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8) 1:8 else 1:26
    
    # Scenario population --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    dat_pop <- dat_phase[which(dat_phase$mod_best == mod_x), ] %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_prob$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
      mutate(scenario = "delay12more",
             bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week) %% 52) <= 12) %>%
      crossing(delay = delay_l) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
             age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
  
    # Seroprotection -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    protected_draws <- map_dfr(delay_l, \(delay_x) {
      dat_pop_x <- filter(dat_pop, delay == delay_x)

      # Seroprotection under the delayed scenario by draw
      protected_scenario_draws <- dat_pop_x %>%
        left_join(dat_prob, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
                  relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        filter(age_ini <= (max(age_ini) - max(delay))) %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
        summarise(protected = sum(n * prob) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")

      # Calculate comparisons within matched posterior draws
      ratio_draws <- protected_scenario_draws %>%
        left_join(protected_base_draws, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw)) %>%
        left_join(protected_late_draws, by = join_by(pat,mod_best, clu, min_week, draw)) %>%
        mutate(
          ratio_baseline_draw = protected / protected_baseline,
          increase_pct_draw = 100 * (ratio_baseline_draw - 1),
          gap_closed_draw = (protected - protected_baseline) / (protected_late - protected_baseline),
          gap_closed_pct_draw = 100 * gap_closed_draw) %>%
        mutate(across(c(ratio_baseline_draw, increase_pct_draw, gap_closed_draw, gap_closed_pct_draw),
                      ~ if_else(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
      # Summarise posterior distributions
      ratio_draws %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay) %>%
        summarise(
          protected_mean = mean(protected, na.rm = TRUE),
          protected_med = median(protected, na.rm = TRUE),
          protected_cilo = quantile(protected, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          protected_ciup = quantile(protected, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_baseline = median(ratio_baseline_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_baseline_cilo = quantile(ratio_baseline_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_baseline_ciup = quantile(ratio_baseline_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          increase_pct = median(increase_pct_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          increase_pct_cilo = quantile(increase_pct_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          increase_pct_ciup = quantile(increase_pct_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed = median(gap_closed_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed_cilo = quantile(gap_closed_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed_ciup = quantile(gap_closed_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed_pct = median(gap_closed_pct_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed_pct_cilo = quantile(gap_closed_pct_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          gap_closed_pct_ciup = quantile(gap_closed_pct_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop")
    })
    
    return(protected_draws)
  })
})
```

# Plots ============================================================================================

```{r}
# Vaccines given later 
mmrvhav <- c("measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv", "hav")
```

```{r}
pldat <- list()
pl_l <- list()
pldat$baseline <- sim_baseline %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = pat %in% mmrvhav,
         age_min = if_else(mmrvhav, 26, 6),
         age_rec = if_else(mmrvhav, 52, 8)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) 

pl_l$baseline <- pldat$baseline %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = protected_mean, x = age_ini)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = age_min), color = "dodgerblue") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = age_rec), color = "firebrick1") + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = protected_cilo, ymax = protected_ciup)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Seroprotection") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Age of vaccination (weeks)") + 
  labs(title = "Seroprotection by age of first vaccination", 
       "Blue line is the minimum recommended age, red line is the recommended age of vaccination") + 
  facet_nested_wrap(~reorder(pat_tidy, mmrvhav)+clu_tidy, scales = "free", nest_line =TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 8)
```

```{r}
    filter(clu == "1_Temperate", age == 38, sex == "M"))

datone_pop <- dat_phase[c(1,21), ] %>%
  mutate(age_ini = if_else(pat == "vzv", 38, 6)) %>%
  crossing(birth_week = c(1:52)) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1, n = 1000)
```

# Data delay06moreless
```{r}
pldat$delay06moreless <- list()
pldat$delay06moreless$result <- sim_delay06moreless %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = pat %in% mmrvhav,
         age_min = if_else(mmrvhav, 26, 6),
         age_rec = if_else(mmrvhav, 52, 8)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) %>%
  filter(age_ini <= age_rec & age_ini >= age_min)

pldat$delay06moreless$pop <- datone_pop %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = pat %in% mmrvhav) %>%
  mutate(
    delay = if_else(mmrvhav, 14, 4),
    scenario = "delay06moreless",
    bad_season = abs(((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26) <= 6,
    vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
    age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))

pldat$delay06moreless$prob <- datone_prob %>%
  select(-age) %>%
  left_join(
   group_by(pldat$delay06moreless$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, min_week) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1)) %>%
  left_join(
    group_by(pldat$delay06moreless$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, age, age_ini) %>%
    summarise(n_age = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1)) 
```

```{r}
pl_l$delay06moreless <- list()
pl_l$delay06moreless$pl1 <- pldat$delay06moreless$prob %>%
  group_split(pat) %>%
  purrr::map(\(dat) {
    filter(dat, !is.na(age)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = prob_med)) +
      geom_point(data = dat, color = "transparent") + 
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = min_week), color = "grey") +
      geom_point(aes(size = n, color = reorder(as.factor(age), age))) + 
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Count", breaks = c(1000, 2000)) + 
      scale_color_viridis_d("Age of vaccination \n(weeks)") +
      scale_y_continuous("Seroprotection") +
      scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1, 18, 35, 52), expand = c(0,0)) +
      facet_wrap(~pat_tidy, scales = "free_y") +
      guides(size  = guide_legend(order = 1), color = guide_legend(order = 2))
  }) %>%
  wrap_plots()

  ggplot(aes(x = delay, y = protected_mean)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = protected_cilo, ymax = protected_ciup)) +

pl_l$delay06moreless$final <- free(pl_l$delay06moreless$pl1) + (pl_l$delay06moreless$pl2|pl_l$delay06moreless$pl3) + plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 5)) + 
  plot_annotation("Scenario: Delayed vaccination to the children within 6 weeks before and after of the worse seroprotection week",
          "Children supposed to be vaccinated within those weeks are then vaccinated with a delay (they are older and the vaccination timing is better) \nGrey boxes represent the population seroprotected without delay, lines represent the population seroprotected with the delay") 
ggsave("../_Figures/Figure_delay06moreless.pdf", pl_l$delay06moreless$final, width = 10, height = 18)
```

```{r}
pldat$delay12more$result <- sim_delay12more %>%

    bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week) %% 52) <= 12,
    vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
    age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))

pldat$delay12more$prob <- datone_prob %>%
  select(-age) %>%
  left_join(
   group_by(pldat$delay12more$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, min_week) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1)) %>%
  left_join(
    group_by(pldat$delay12more$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, age, age_ini) %>%
    summarise(n_age = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1))
```

# Data delayout
```{r}
pldat$delayout <- list()
pldat$delayout$result <- sim_delayout %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = pat %in% mmrvhav,
         age_min = if_else(mmrvhav, 26, 6),
         age_rec = if_else(mmrvhav, 52, 8),
         bad_window > 1, bad_window < 12) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) %>%
  filter(age_ini <= age_rec & age_ini >= age_min)

pldat$delayout$pop <- datone_pop %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = pat %in% mmrvhav) %>%
  mutate(
    bad_window = if_else(mmrvhav, 12, 4),
    weeks_before = floor((bad_window - 1) / 2),
    weeks_after  = ceiling((bad_window - 1) / 2),
    week_from_min = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26,
    bad_season = week_from_min >= -weeks_before & week_from_min <=  weeks_after,
    out_season = ((min_week + weeks_after) %% 52) + 1,
    delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
    vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
    age = age_ini + delay)

pldat$delayout$prob <- datone_prob %>%
  select(-age) %>%
  left_join(
   group_by(pldat$delayout$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, min_week) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1)) %>%
  left_join(
    group_by(pldat$delayout$pop, pat, vac_week_v1, age, age_ini) %>%
    summarise(n_age = sum(n), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(pat, vac_week_v1))
```

```{r}
dat_ini <- data.frame(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = 8, min_week = 20) %>%

datsce_l <- list()
# Scenario 1: Baseline 
datsce_l$baseline_early <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "baseline",
         bad_season = FALSE,
         delay = 0,
         vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
         age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
datsce_l$baseline_late <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "baseline",
         bad_season = TRUE,
         delay = 4,
         vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
         age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
# Scenario 2: 6 weeks more or less
datsce_l$delay06moreless <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay06moreless",
         bad_season = abs(((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26) <= 6,
         delay = 4,
         vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
         age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
# Scenario 3: 6 weeks more or less
datsce_l$delay12more <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay12more",
         bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week) %% 52) <= 12,
         delay = 4,
         vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
         age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
# Scenario 4: Out of 4 weeks bad season 
datsce_l$delay04out <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay04out",
         bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 >= -1 & 
                      ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 <= 2,
         out_season = ((min_week + 3 - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
         vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         age = age_ini + delay)
# Scenario 5: Out of 8 weeks bad season 
datsce_l$delay08out <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay08out",
         bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 >= -3 & 
                      ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 <= 4,
         out_season = ((min_week + 5 - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
         vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         age = age_ini + delay) 

pl_sce <- purrr::map(datsce_l, \(dat) {
  dat %>%
    count(vac_week_v1) %>%
    tidyr::complete(vac_week_v1 = 1:52, fill = list(n = 0))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(vac_week_v1, levels = 1:52), y = n)) +

})
```

```{r}
                      ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 <= 13,
         out_season = ((min_week + 14 - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
         vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         age = age_ini + delay) 
# Scenario 5: Out of 8 weeks bad season 
datsce_l$delay52out <- dat_ini %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay13out",
         bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 >= -26 & 
                      ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26 <= 27,
         out_season = ((min_week + 28 - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         delay = if_else(bad_season, (out_season - vac_week_v1_ini + 52) %% 52, 0),
         vac_week_v1 = ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1,
         age = age_ini + delay) 

pl_sce <- purrr::map(datsce_l, \(dat) {
  dat %>%
    count(vac_week_v1) %>%
    tidyr::complete(vac_week_v1 = 1:52, fill = list(n = 0))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(vac_week_v1, levels = 1:52), y = n)) +
    geom_col(color = "white") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 20), color = "red") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 46), color = "forestgreen") +
    scale_x_discrete("Vaccination week", drop = FALSE) +
  dat %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(as.factor(age), age))) +
    geom_histogram(stat="count") +
    scale_x_discrete("Vaccination age") + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(4,1))
})
pl_sce$delay52out
```

# Estimate probability above threshold for a range of ages and all vaccination weeks 

# Range of ages 
```{r}
# Population assumptions
sim_vacage_young <- c(4:18)
sim_vacage_old <- c(26:78)
sim_ndraws <- 1000
```

```{r}
source("../fun_mod/fun_venewdata.R")
prob_threshold_files <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), function(x) {
  # For each model 
  datmod_x <- filter(dat_mod, mod_best == dat_cov$mod_best[x]) %>% slice(1)
  
  # Define vaccination ages ========================================================================
  vacage_x <- if (dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8) sim_vacage_young else sim_vacage_old
  
  # Define paths (model_age_delay_draws)  ==========================================================
  path_prob <- as.character(glue(
    "{dirs$modres}/modres_population/prob_{str_remove(dat_cov$mod_best[x], '[.]rds$')}_",
    "age{min(vacage_x)}to{max(vacage_x)}_", "draw{sim_ndraws}.rds"))
  path_mod <- file.path("/Volumes/ExternalSSD_LABG_Work/_seas_imm_backup/outputs/models",
                        datmod_x$pat[1], datmod_x$mod_best[1])
  path_dat <- paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", str_remove_all(datmod_x$dat[1], "_|s08"), "_brms_", 
                     datmod_x$pat[1], "_v", datmod_x$vac[1], "_s08.rds")
  
  # Obtain probability =============================================================================
  prob <- pomp::bake(path_prob, dir = "", {
  message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {dat_cov$mod_best[x]}"))
    
    # Gather the data 
    mod <- readRDS(path_mod)
    dat <- readRDS(path_dat)
    datcov_x <- dat_cov[x, ]
      
    # Create new data for vaccination ages before and after the delay ------------------------------
    clu_name <- str_remove_all(datmod_x$mod_name_best[1], "csi_")
    age_pred <- c(vacage_x)
    
    # This new data has each individual times the different factors and for each age selected 
    newdat <- fun_venewdat(dat, datcov_x, clu_name) %>%
      filter(age == datcov_x$age_fixed[[1]]) %>%
      select(-age) %>%
      crossing(age = age_pred) %>%
      relocate(age, .after = sex)
    
    # Filter new data to keep just one vac_name_v1, doses, and only included clusters 
    if (datmod_x$pat[1] == "dipht" & "vac_name_v1" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, vac_name_v1 != "dtpa") }
    if (str_detect(datmod_x$pat[1], "strep") &
        "vac_name_v1" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, vac_name_v1 == "strep10") }
    if (datmod_x$pat[1] == "rota" & "doses" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, doses != "3") }
    if (clu_name != "cs") {
      clu_included <- all_datagapssim %>%
        filter(mod == datmod_x$mod_best[1], included == TRUE) %>%
        pull(clu)
      newdat <- filter(newdat, str_remove_all(as.character(.data[[clu_name]]), " ") %in% clu_included) }
    
    # Obtain a sample of posterior draws
    draw_id <- sample(seq_len(ndraws(mod)), min(sim_ndraws, ndraws(mod)))
      
    # Obtain probability above from Gamma distribution ---------------------------------------------
    mu <- posterior_epred(mod, newdata = newdat, re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_id)
    shape <- as_draws_df(mod)$shape[draw_id]
    prob_mat <- pgamma(q = datcov_x$threshold_protect[[1]], shape = shape, rate = shape / mu, 
                       lower.tail = FALSE) %>% t()
    colnames(prob_mat) <- paste0("draw_", draw_id)
      
    # Keep posterior draws for the population simulation
    prob_draws <- newdat %>%
      bind_cols(as_tibble(prob_mat)) %>%
      pivot_longer(starts_with("draw_"), names_to = "draw", values_to = "prob") %>%
      mutate(draw = as.integer(str_remove(draw, "draw_")))
      
    # Add clu variable 
    if (clu_name != "cs") prob_draws <- rename(prob_draws, clu = all_of(clu_name))
    if (!"clu" %in% names(prob_draws)) prob_draws <- mutate(prob_draws, clu = NA)
    
    prob_draws %>%
      mutate(clu = str_replace_all(clu, " ", ""),
             mod_best = datmod_x$mod_best[1],
             pat = datmod_x$pat[1])
  })
  return(path_prob)
})
```

# Define bad season

```{r}
# Obtain posterior median probability per week
prob_week <- map_dfr(prob_threshold_files, function(prob_file) {
  readRDS(prob_file) %>%
    group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, age, vac_week_v1) %>%
    summarise(prob_med = median(prob), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, age) %>%
    mutate(
      prob_cutoff = min(prob_med),
      min_week = vac_week_v1[which.min(prob_med)],
      bad_season_06moreless = abs(((vac_week_v1 - min_week + 26) %% 52) - 26) <= 6,
      bad_season_12more = ((vac_week_v1 - min_week) %% 52) <= 12) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
  mutate(bad_season_06moreless_4wdelay = ((vac_week_v1 - 4 - 1) %% 52 + 1) %in% vac_week_v1[bad_season_06moreless],
         bad_season_12more_4wdelay = ((vac_week_v1 - 4 - 1) %% 52 + 1) %in% vac_week_v1[bad_season_12more])
})
```

# Simulate population ==============================================================================

```{r}
# Function to return week of year
fun_week <- function(x) ((x - 1) %% 52) + 1

# Create the same number of children born each week
dat_pop <- prob_week %>%
  distinct(pat, mod_best, clu) %>%
  inner_join(dat_scenarios %>% distinct(pat, mod_best, vac_age), by = join_by(pat, mod_best), 
             relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  crossing(birth_week = 1:52, sex = c("M", "F")) %>%
  mutate(
    n = sim_nbirth_week / 2,
    vac_age_base = vac_age,
    vac_week_base = fun_week(birth_week + vac_age)) %>%
  left_join(select(prob_week, pat, mod_best, clu, vac_age_base = age, vac_week_base = vac_week_v1,
                   bad_season_06moreless), by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, vac_age_base, vac_week_base))
```

# Define targeted vaccination strategy

```{r}
# Delay all children whose vaccination falls in the bad season by x weeks
dat_strategy <- dat_pop %>%
  inner_join(dat_scenarios, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, vac_age), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(
    delay = if_else(bad_season_06moreless, delay_weeks, 0),
    vac_age_strategy = vac_age_base + delay,
    vac_week_strategy = fun_week(vac_week_base + delay),
    vac_age_all_delayed = vac_age_base + delay_weeks,
    vac_week_all_delayed = fun_week(vac_week_base + delay_weeks))

# Check how many children are moved
dat_strategy %>%
  group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, vac_age, delay_weeks) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = sum(n),
    n_bad_season = sum(n[bad_season_06moreless]),
    n_delayed = sum(n[delay > 0]),
    delay_median = if_else(any(delay > 0), median(delay[delay > 0]), 0),
    delay_applied = max(delay),
    .groups = "drop")
```

# Compare fixed vaccination age and targeted delay

```{r}
# Process one model at a time to avoid keeping all posterior predictions in memory
dat_sim_sum <- map_dfr(prob_threshold_files, function(prob_file) {
  prob_threshold <- readRDS(prob_file)
  
  dat_strategy_x <- dat_strategy %>%
    semi_join(prob_threshold %>% distinct(pat, mod_best), by = join_by(pat, mod_best))
  
  # Probability under early vaccination
  prob_base <- prob_threshold %>%
    select(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_base = age, vac_week_base = vac_week_v1,
           prob_base = prob)
  
  # Probability under targeted later vaccination
  prob_strategy <- prob_threshold %>%
    select(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_strategy = age, vac_week_strategy = vac_week_v1, 
           prob_strategy_draw = prob)
  
  # Probability when all children are vaccinated later
  prob_all_delayed <- prob_threshold %>%
    select(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_all_delayed = age, 
           vac_week_all_delayed = vac_week_v1, prob_all_delayed_draw = prob)
  
  # Combine population and posterior probabilities
  dat_sim <- dat_strategy_x %>%
  left_join(prob_threshold %>% distinct(pat, mod_best, draw), by = join_by(pat, mod_best), 
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  left_join(prob_base, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_base, vac_week_base)) %>%
  left_join(prob_strategy, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_strategy, vac_week_strategy)) %>%
  left_join(prob_all_delayed, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, draw, vac_age_all_delayed, vac_week_all_delayed)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Expected number above threshold
    n_exp_base = n * prob_base,
    n_exp_strategy = n * prob_strategy_draw,
    n_exp_all_delayed = n * prob_all_delayed_draw,
    # Simulated number above threshold
    n_sim_base = rbinom(n(), size = n, prob = prob_base),
    n_sim_strategy = rbinom(n(), size = n, prob = prob_strategy_draw),
    n_sim_all_delayed = rbinom(n(), size = n, prob = prob_all_delayed_draw))

  # Sum results over all birth weeks and sexes
  dat_sim %>%
    group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, vac_age, delay_weeks, draw) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = sum(n),
      n_delayed = sum(n[delay > 0]),
      n_exp_base = sum(n_exp_base),
      n_exp_strategy = sum(n_exp_strategy),
      n_exp_all_delayed = sum(n_exp_all_delayed),
      n_sim_base = sum(n_sim_base),
      n_sim_strategy = sum(n_sim_strategy),
      n_sim_all_delayed = sum(n_sim_all_delayed),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      prop_exp_base = n_exp_base / n_total,
      prop_exp_strategy = n_exp_strategy / n_total,
      prop_exp_all_delayed = n_exp_all_delayed / n_total,
      n_exp_diff = n_exp_strategy - n_exp_base,
      prop_exp_diff = prop_exp_strategy - prop_exp_base,
      n_sim_diff = n_sim_strategy - n_sim_base,
      prop_exp_targeted_vs_all = prop_exp_strategy - prop_exp_all_delayed)
})
```

####################################################################################################
# Notes
####################################################################################################

Only assays classified as accepted in thresholds_immvacc.xlsx are included. The same assay, vaccine,
model, and cluster exclusions used in the VE results are applied. Pathogens whose best model is the
nonseasonal base model are not included.

The main analysis defines the bad season as the 25% of weeks with the lowest predicted probability.
Only children whose original vaccination week falls in the bad season are delayed. The remaining
children are vaccinated at the early age. For comparison, the script also estimates the result if
all children were delayed. Similar values for prop_strategy and prop_all_delayed indicate that a
comparable population above the threshold can be obtained by delaying only the bad-season group.

Vaccines given in infancy use ages 6, 7, and 8 weeks and delays of one to four weeks. Vaccines given
later use ages 26, 39, and 52 weeks and delays of one to 26 weeks. All pathogen, age, region, and
delay scenarios are returned together in pop_summ.

####################################################################################################
# END 
####################################################################################################
